name: PSL tier: Mid/Low Tier Normie

card.summary: The lower-middle bands of the community PSL attractiveness scale, used to describe a face that is ordinary and to decide which features to improve for a higher rating.
card.aka: MTN, LTN, mid tier normie, low tier normie
card.note: An informal, unvalidated rating framework; tier labels are subjective.

quick.overview:
Mid tier normie (MTN) and low tier normie (LTN) are labels in the PSL scale for faces rated around the middle and lower-middle of the distribution, below Chadlite. Members use them to place themselves and to ask what could raise a rating.

The tiers are subjective and not scientifically validated, and raters disagree about boundaries. Threads asking whether someone is MTN or LTN, or asking how to ascend from an MTN base, are common on looksmax.org.
quick.how: Members post photos and ask for a tier, then work on features raters name: skin, body fat, hair, grooming and fitness. Height and facial structure are discussed as limits, and replies often disagree about the result.
quick.risks: The risk is psychological: tier labelling can feed distress and body-image concerns, which commentators have raised about the wider scale. The tiers themselves carry no physical risk.

lead: Mid tier normie (MTN) and low tier normie (LTN) are tiers in the community PSL scale, an informal system for rating male facial attractiveness. They sit in the lower-middle of the scale below Chadlite, and are used for faces seen as ordinary rather than especially attractive or unattractive.[1][2]

Within looksmaxxing the labels work as a starting point: a user who describes himself as an MTN or HTN base asks which changes could lift him, such as weight gain, grooming or fitness.[2] Other members reply with their own ratings, and replies sometimes dispute the placement, for example by calling a self-rating delusional.[2]
PSL is informal and not validated by research; tier boundaries differ between raters and threads, and no study has tested them.

chain: Post photos for a tier rating
Raters name the features holding the score down
Member targets those features to move up a tier
angle.text: Tier labels give members a shared language for comparing faces and choosing what to work on. Any improvement comes from the changes made, such as skin, weight, grooming and fitness, rather than from the label.

paras: Mid and low tier normie are bands of the PSL scale, which has its own wiki entry. Members use them when rating photos and when describing where they started.[1][2]

Thread titles on looksmax.org include requests to be rated as MTN or LTN, and questions about whether MTN is enough when combined with height.[2][3] Members describe a self-improvement plan from an MTN base, and others reply with blunt assessments.[2]
